title: Portrait photograph captioned "John Parangosky" (CIA OXCART history, p. 289)
description: Small head-and-shoulders portrait photograph of a man in a suit and tie, placed in the right margin with the caption "John Parangosky." The surrounding text describes the OXCART's official first flight on 30 April 1962, breaking the sound barrier on 2 May 1962, and efforts to keep the A-12 secret from air traffic controllers via the FAA and NORAD.
